paite: TOUPA aw, kou hon pe lou in, koumau hon pe lou in, na min thupina pe zaw in, na zahngaihna leh na thutak ziak in.
heading: Pathian Dik Khat

paite: Bang achia namte'n, "A Pathian uh koi a om ahia?" chi uh ahia?
Ka Pathian uh van ah a-om a; a-utut ahih ahi.
Amilimte uh dangka leh dangka-eng ahi ua, mihing khutsuak ahi uh.
Kam anei ua, apau kei uh; mit anei ua, amu kei uh;
bil anei ua, aza kei uh; nak anei ua, gim aza kei uh;
khut anei ua, bangmah akhoih kei uh; khe anei ua, apai kei uh; agawl tungtawn un apau sam kei uhi.
Amau bawlte amaute bang ahi ding ua; ahi, huai muang peuhmahte.
Israelte aw, TOUPA muang un; amah amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh ahi.
Aaron inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA muang un, amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh amah ahi.
TOUPA laute aw, TOUPA muang un, amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh ahi.
TOUPA'N hon theigige a; avualzawl ding, Israel inkuante avualzawl ding a, Aaron inkuante avualzawl ding hi.
TOUPA laute avualzawl ding, aneu leh alian in.
TOUPA'N nou hon pungsak hen, nou leh na tate uh toh.
TOUPA vualzawlna mute na hi uh, amah lei leh van siampa ahi.
Vante TOUPA vante ahi a; leitung mihing tate kiang ah apia hi.
Misite'n TOUPA aphat kei ua, mundaitak a paisukte peuhmah in aphat sam kei uh;
kou bel TOUPA ka phat ding uh, tu a kipan tangtawn in, TOUPA phat un.
